earnings.title: Linsey Wisniewski
highlights: GAAP Net Income of $1.42 per share and Adjusted (non-GAAP) Operating Earnings of $2.55 per share for the second quarter of 2026
Our GAAP Net Income for the second quarter of 2026 decreased to $1.42 per share from $2.67 per share in the second quarter of 2025.
GAAP Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Common Shareholders $ 513 $ 1.42 $ 839 $ 2.67
Earnings per share amount is based on average diluted common shares outstanding of 360 million and 314 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively.

quotes.text: This quarter's accomplishments reflect the momentum we're building across our business.
quotes.by: Joe Dominguez, president and CEO of Constellation

quotes.text: Our second-quarter results and increased full-year EPS guidance demonstrate the earnings power of our expanded platform, strong operational and commercial performance, and the disciplined execution of our capital allocation strategy.
quotes.by: Shane Smith, executive vice president and chief financial officer of Constellation

outlook: Raising full-year Adjusted (non-GAAP) Operating Earnings guidance range to $11.50 – $12.50 per share
